text: Does an athlete have to look a certain way to perform at their best?
Athletes can have different body types: ectomorph, mesomorph or endomorph.
Different shapes. Different physical characteristics. But body shape alone does not determine sporting ability.
Because in sports, what matters is not just how your body looks. It's what your body can do.
Your strength, speed, endurance, agility, mobility and, most importantly, your game output.
Unlike bodybuilding, where physique and muscular development are central goals, sports performance is about delivering results in your game.
Every sport has different physical demands. Every athlete has different needs.
That's why every athlete needs to be understood individually.
Through necessary assessments, sport-specific fitness goals and continuous training, athletes must keep developing their physical capabilities.
Different physiques. Different sports. Different requirements. One focus: better performance.
Sports Science Technology. Understanding the athlete beyond physique.
